function.arguments: {"reflection":"The first search establishes a useful source set: RFJ gives an official RaaS description, aliases, Wizard Spider linkage, victim scale, Russian-government-linked assessment, and associated tools; Rapid7 documents the 2022 chat leak and cautions that encrypted/incomplete material and alleged credentials should not be treated as verified facts; CIS summarizes leaked organizational roles, budgets, staffing, affiliate economics, and reorganization, but is secondary and partly reports Krebs. DOJ gives a case hub, named defendants, charges, plea update, and presumption-of-innocence language. Missing are primary advisories, charging documents, sanctions, detailed alias-to-defendant mappings, affidavits, pleas/sentencings, and precise leak evidence. Search narrower official sources next."}
function.name: think_tool
